page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results show strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested systems. The instance demonstrates high efficiency in software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth is highly competitive, uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average tier. Cryptographic and database operations also rank in the top 25%, alongside strong text generation speeds for small language models.

The absence of local NVMe storage represents a key tradeoff, requiring reliance on network storage for I/O-heavy operations. Qualitatively, the dedicated AMD EPYC hardware offers a balanced resource density for enterprise workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances. The instance is suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation pipelines, database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks.
